start.content: Keep moving, scribe. Do not look at me directly. I am cataloguing the faces near the treasury gates.

catalogue.content: The faces of the men who came to hear the Galilean today. The chief priests, the scribes, the Pharisees — they all came with questions. He answered every one.

employer.content: The High Priest's household employs many watchers. I watch the Temple because the Temple is where power assembles. And power, when challenged, remembers.

closing.content: Say nothing. The treasury walls have ears. The Galilean's words are being weighed, and the scales do not favour Him.
